featured.title: Nepal Flood Death Toll Surges Past 330 as Glacier Collapse Scale Becomes Clear
featured.excerpt: Scientists confirm an ice-rock avalanche, not an earthquake, triggered one of Nepal's worst natural disasters, with over 900 people still missing including dozens of Americans and 177 Indian pilgrims.
featured.image_caption: An aerial view shows houses buried under mud and debris following flash floods in Nepal on August 26, 2026. The floods killed over 330 people and left more than 900 missing across eight districts.
featured.nri_angle: 177 Indian pilgrims en route to Kailash Mansarovar are among the missing, 63 Americans unaccounted for, and downstream flooding prompted evacuations in Bihar — the disaster has direct implications for diaspora families across South Asia.
featured.author: Diaspora Desk

editorial.title: Who Is Anil Chakravarthy? The Bengaluru Boy Who Became a Chancellor's Gold Medalist, an MIT PhD, a Silicon Valley CEO — and Now Adobe's Next Leader
editorial.excerpt: Adobe's board has named Anil Chakravarthy as its next president and CEO, making him the second consecutive Indian-origin leader at the helm of the creative software giant. His journey from Basavanagudi to the C-suite is a story of quiet, methodical ambition.
editorial.image_caption: Anil Chakravarthy, who has been named Adobe's next CEO effective December 1, 2026, succeeding Shantanu Narayen.
editorial.nri_angle: Adobe's CEO succession from one Indian-origin leader to another underscores the growing dominance of Indian-educated executives in global tech leadership.
editorial.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: IndiGo Flight from Lucknow to Dammam Makes Emergency Landing in Ahmedabad After Bomb Note Found
just_in.excerpt: All 107 passengers and six crew on flight 6E97 were deplaned safely; nothing suspicious was found after searches by police, CISF, and bomb disposal squads.
just_in.nri_angle: The Lucknow-Dammam route is heavily used by Indian migrant workers in the Gulf, for whom such disruptions mean missed workdays and connecting-flight chaos.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Trump Administration Moves to Scrap H-1B 60-Day Grace Period After Job Loss
just_in.excerpt: A DHS proposal published September 10 would require H-1B and other temporary workers to leave the U.S. as soon as employment ends - with Indian professionals the most exposed.
just_in.nri_angle: Indian nationals were about 71 percent of successful H-1B applicants in fiscal 2024, so eliminating the grace period would turn any tech layoff into an immediate departure order for Indian workers and their families.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: India Hosts BRICS Summit as Iran War Divides the Bloc's Newest Members
just_in.excerpt: Leaders from 11 BRICS nations gather in New Delhi on September 12-13, with the U.S.-led war on Iran - pitting Iran against fellow member UAE - testing the bloc's ability to issue a joint declaration.
just_in.nri_angle: Millions of Indian workers in the UAE and Gulf face direct exposure to the regional escalation, while crude above $100 a barrel hits India's import bill and the purchasing power of remittances - and the summit tests the strategic-autonomy leadership the diaspora watches closely.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: India-Canada Trade Deal by End of 2026 Is 'Very Realistic,' Envoy Says
just_in.excerpt: High Commissioner Chris Cooter says the political push from Prime Ministers Modi and Carney, plus strong business interest, makes the Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement timeline achievable.
just_in.nri_angle: A completed CEPA would directly benefit the Indo-Canadian business community through easier movement of goods, services, and professionals between the two countries.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: India Women's Spinners Bundle Pakistan Out for 55 in Asia Cup Rout
just_in.excerpt: Left-arm spinner Shree Charani's 3 for 7 led a spin masterclass in Dubai, and Harmanpreet Kaur sealed a seven-wicket win in 8.4 overs in her 150th T20I as captain.
just_in.nri_angle: India-Pakistan cricket is appointment viewing for the South Asian diaspora, and this rout gave fans across the US, Canada, UK and the Gulf a night to savour.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Tanya Chaudhary Smashes National Hammer Throw Record Days Before Asian Games
just_in.excerpt: The Uttar Pradesh athlete sent the hammer to 68.35m at the Indian Athletics Series Final on Thursday, breaking 18-year-old Anushka Yadav's record with the Aichi-Nagoya Games beginning September 19.
just_in.nri_angle: India's rising women's hammer throw, led by Chaudhary and Yadav, gives diaspora track fans a genuine medal hope at the Aichi-Nagoya Games.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: 'Gone in a Blink': Nepal Floods Sweep Away Indian Migrant Workers
just_in.excerpt: Survivors Neyaz Miya and Mehadi Hassan watched the Syafrubesi hotels they had helped build disappear on August 26; three colleagues from their Bihar village remain missing.
just_in.nri_angle: The disaster struck the open-border migration corridor between India and Nepal, where lakhs of Indian workers earn their families' livelihoods — a story that lands directly with the diaspora and their families back home.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Georgia Teen Anannya Aneesh Earns Spot at 2027 U19 Women's World Cup
just_in.excerpt: The Mountain View High School senior helped the USA Women's U19 team sweep the Americas Qualifier to reach the 2027 ICC U19 Women's T20 World Cup.
just_in.nri_angle: Aneesh's arc — falling in love with cricket through the IPL with her father in Georgia, representing the USA, and planning to play in India — runs the full arc of the diaspora cricket dream.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Floating Cinema Brings Bollywood Classics to Srinagar's Dal Lake
just_in.excerpt: Srinagar's Dal Lake became an open-air cinema as the inaugural Jammu & Kashmir film festival screened Bollywood classics to audiences on shikaras and the lakefront.
just_in.image_caption: Houseboats on Dal Lake in Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir. The floating cinema of the International Film Festival of Jammu & Kashmir screened Bollywood classics from the lakefront, with audiences watching in shikaras.
just_in.nri_angle: For diaspora audiences who grew up on these classics, the floating cinema revives a shared cinematic inheritance — Kashmir's Bollywood-era imagery shown on the water where it was filmed.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Hema Malini Credits 'Hanuman Ji Ki Kripa' for 'Hanuman Ansh' Rs 150-Crore Run
just_in.excerpt: The veteran actor said she was "very happy" the Neem Karoli Baba devotional drama became a box-office phenomenon, and praised first-time producer Anupriya Nagar for backing it.
just_in.nri_angle: Hanuman Ansh releases internationally on September 11, 2026, bringing the sleeper devotional hit to diaspora theatres in the US, UK and Gulf.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Chidambaram Questions India's BRICS Gains; BJP Calls It 'Disgruntled Uncle' Attitude
just_in.excerpt: P. Chidambaram said the last two or three BRICS summits delivered no tangible benefits for India. BJP leader Ram Madhav fired back with a "naraz phupha" jibe as the 2026 New Delhi summit approaches.
just_in.nri_angle: BRICS debates shape trade, energy and investment conditions that directly affect NRI households, and India's 2026 chairmanship puts New Delhi's agenda-setting in the spotlight for the diaspora.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: India Rout Pakistan 19-0 to Storm Into Junior Women's Hockey Asia Cup Semis
just_in.excerpt: India's junior women thrashed Pakistan 19-0 in their Women's Junior Asia Cup quarterfinal in Moqi, China — Pooja Malik hit a hat-trick and the defending champions, now two wins from a third straight continental title, face the South Korea-Malaysia winner in the semifinals.
just_in.image_caption: Action from the India-Pakistan match at the Women's Junior Asia Cup in Moqi, China. India won the quarterfinal 19-0 to storm into the semifinals.
just_in.nri_angle: For diaspora families whose kids play field hockey in US and Canadian leagues, this junior side — defending champions now two wins from a three-peat — is the next generation to watch, with several of these names likely to step into the senior India squad within a year or two.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: CEPI Gives Pune's Immunoscript $8.9M for Freezer-Free RNA Vaccines
just_in.excerpt: The Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations will fund Pune-based Immunoscript Life Science with up to $8.9 million to advance clinical testing of its thermostable self-amplifying RNA vaccine platform — a key piece of the global '100 Days Mission' to prepare for Disease X.
just_in.image_caption: Dr Sanjay Singh, founder and chief executive of Immunoscript Life Science. CEPI has committed up to $8.9 million to the Pune company for clinical testing of its freezer-free RNA vaccine platform.
just_in.nri_angle: For the Indian diaspora — many of whom flew relatives home for COVID shots or funded vaccine drives — a thermostable RNA platform built in India could one day mean outbreak response that reaches grandparents in villages as fast as it reaches cities.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Bumrah Included, Yash Thakur Replaces Harshit Rana in India T20I Squads
just_in.excerpt: The BCCI on Thursday named Vidarbha pacer Yash Thakur as Harshit Rana's replacement for the Afghanistan T20Is and the 2026 Asian Games after Rana suffered a rectus femoris strain during a match simulation, while Jasprit Bumrah, Nitish Kumar Reddy and Washington Sundar all made the cut.
just_in.image_caption: India fast bowler Yash Thakur trains with the national squad. The 27-year-old Vidarbha pacer was named as Harshit Rana's replacement for the Afghanistan T20Is and the 2026 Asian Games.
just_in.nri_angle: For Indian fans in the US, UK and Canada who follow the team through late-night streams and diaspora watch parties, a settled pace attack — Bumrah back, Thakur blooded — sets the tone for the home season and the Asian Games campaign in Nagoya.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Accenture, Google Cloud Launch Unit Deploying 1,000 AI Engineers On-Site
just_in.excerpt: Google Cloud will train up to 1,000 Accenture engineers to work inside client offices building AI applications — the industry's latest bet that embedded, forward-deployed talent is the key to AI returns.
just_in.image_caption: The Google Cloud logo on display. Accenture and Google Cloud have formed the Accenture Gemini Enterprise Business Group, which will train up to 1,000 engineers to deploy agentic AI inside client offices.
just_in.nri_angle: Accenture's large Indian-origin workforce and India's global capability centers sit at the center of the enterprise AI deployment wave this new unit aims to staff.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: India to Pitch RBI-Backed Digital Currency Link for BRICS Payments at Summit
news.excerpt: New Delhi will push its proposal to link BRICS central bank digital currencies at the leaders' summit on September 12-13, according to Reuters — but low adoption and political frictions cloud its prospects.
news.image_caption: The flags of Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa, the founding members of the BRICS bloc. India will push a proposal to link the bloc's central bank digital currencies for cross-border payments at the leaders' summit in New Delhi on September 12-13.
news.nri_angle: A working CBDC link could lower cross-border payment costs for Indian workers in the Gulf and give Indian exporters a non-dollar settlement rail.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: India Objects to UN Map Depicting Arunachal, Aksai Chin as Separate Regions
news.excerpt: New Delhi has engaged UN authorities over a world map showing Arunachal Pradesh and Aksai Chin as separate regions, insisting its vote for the 'Correct the Map' resolution endorsed no border claims.
news.nri_angle: Standard UN maps shape textbooks and digital platforms worldwide, so India's challenge aims to stop an inaccurate depiction of its borders from becoming the default the next generation sees.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: India's Aviation Boom Hits Turbulence as Safety Lapses and Losses Mount
news.excerpt: A parliamentary panel found 100 safety lapses at Air India and the DGCA flagged dozens more across carriers, as airlines face nearly $4 billion in combined losses.
news.image_caption: An Air India Express aircraft takes off as a ground worker watches from the field. India’s aviation sector faces mounting safety and financial concerns even as passenger numbers and aircraft orders surge.
news.nri_angle: NRIs are among the heaviest users of India routes; the audit findings and financial strain signal a sector running hot beneath record passenger growth.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Abdullahs Stand for Full Vande Mataram as Congress Urges INDIA Bloc Allies to Follow Suit
news.excerpt: Omar and Farooq Abdullah stood through all six stanzas of the national song at a Srinagar film festival, exposing a rift within the opposition alliance over the Vande Mataram debate.
news.image_caption: Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah. The Abdullah family's support for singing the full Vande Mataram marks a notable shift in the party's position on the national song.
news.nri_angle: The Vande Mataram debate resonates with diaspora Indians who navigate questions of national identity, religious pluralism, and the meaning of patriotic symbols from abroad.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Xi and Modi Rebuild Ties as Two Asian Giants Seek Common Ground Before BRICS
news.excerpt: With Xi Jinping set to visit New Delhi for the BRICS summit this week, India and China are moving to repair a relationship damaged by border clashes and trade friction — driven by resumed flights, reopened trade crossings and a shared need to counter US tariff pressure.
news.image_caption: Chinese President Xi Jinping meets Prime Minister Narendra Modi in Tianjin during the SCO summit in August 2025. Xi is expected to visit New Delhi this week for the BRICS summit, his first trip to India in seven years.
news.nri_angle: The India-China diplomatic reset has direct implications for the Indian diaspora, as trade policies, investment flows and geopolitical alignment between the two Asian giants shape economic opportunities and strategic positioning for Indians worldwide.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Manipuri Musician Beaten to Death in Delhi, Reigniting Racial Violence Fears
news.excerpt: Chongtham Vikram Singh, 54, was fatally assaulted outside his home after confronting a group about noise, sparking protests and renewed demands for Northeast community safety.
news.nri_angle: The killing highlights persistent racial discrimination against Northeast Indians, a concern that resonates with diaspora communities who face similar identity-based challenges abroad.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Modi Urges Global UPI Expansion as India Secures 'A' Sovereign Rating After 30 Years
news.excerpt: At Global Fintech Fest 2026 in Mumbai, the Prime Minister cited 7.8% GDP growth and UPI's 24 billion monthly transactions as proof that India's reform momentum is unstoppable.
news.image_caption: Prime Minister Narendra Modi at the Global Fintech Fest 2026 in Mumbai, where he urged expanding UPI internationally and cited India's 7.8 percent GDP growth.
news.nri_angle: Modi directed the fintech sector to integrate UPI with payment systems in countries where Indians live in large numbers, aiming to cut remittance costs for the world's largest diaspora.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: 175-Year-Old West Bengal Temple Collapses Into Ganges as Erosion Breaches Barriers
news.excerpt: Severe riverbank erosion overwhelmed protective barriers and sandbag reinforcements around the historic structure, the second temple lost to the Ganges in less than a week.
news.image_caption: A 175-year-old temple on the banks of the Ganges in West Bengal collapsed on September 7 after severe erosion breached protective barriers.
news.nri_angle: Heritage sites along the Ganges hold deep cultural significance for the diaspora, and the twin collapses highlight threats from environmental change.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: Telangana Assembly Erupts as Speaker Breaks Down Over Alleged Caste Slurs by BRS Lawmaker
news.excerpt: BRS MLC Tata Madhu was arrested for allegedly using derogatory language against Dalit Speaker Gaddam Prasad Kumar during a protest outside the Assembly, with CM Revanth Reddy calling it a "dark day for Telangana."
news.image_caption: The Telangana Legislative Assembly in Hyderabad. The assembly erupted in disorder after the Speaker broke down over alleged caste slurs by a BRS lawmaker.
news.nri_angle: Caste-based attacks on a constitutional officeholder challenge democratic norms that diaspora Indians regard as fundamental to India's governance.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: India Clears ₹1.1 Lakh Crore Defence Acquisition With 98% Sourced From Domestic Industry
news.excerpt: The Defence Acquisition Council approved procurement proposals spanning CBRN vehicles, marine gas turbines and advanced helicopters for all three services, with nearly all sourcing from Indian manufacturers.
news.image_caption: India has cleared defence acquisitions worth ₹1.1 lakh crore, with 98 percent sourced from domestic industry under the Make in India initiative.
news.nri_angle: The expanding Indian defence manufacturing pipeline creates potential opportunities for Indian-origin defence technology professionals abroad.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: UK Recognises India's Carbon Credit Scheme, Easing Carbon Tax Burden on Exporters
news.excerpt: Britain has included India's Carbon Credit Trading Scheme in its qualifying list under the UK CBAM, allowing Indian exporters to claim relief on carbon-intensive goods shipped to the UK.
news.image_caption: The United Kingdom has recognised India's carbon credit trading scheme, potentially easing the carbon tax burden on Indian exporters.
news.nri_angle: Indian-origin UK business owners importing carbon-intensive goods from India stand to benefit from lower CBAM compliance costs under the recognition.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: 'Who Says There's No Theft in US?': Indian Family's Car Found Without Wheels
nri-world.excerpt: The woman woke to find the family's parked car resting on supports with all four wheels gone — and a note left behind warning of a string of thefts at the parking lot.
nri-world.nri_angle: Many Indian families live in US apartment complexes with shared parking lots, and the incident has resonated widely with the diaspora — a familiar reminder that crime is a fact of life everywhere, not just back home.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Kerala NRI Panel Warns Job Seekers as Visa Scams Top Complaint List
nri-world.excerpt: Over 30% of the 268 complaints received this year involve financial fraud built on fake work-visa promises, chairperson Sophy Thomas said.
nri-world.image_caption: An illustration of a smartphone with a prohibition symbol over a job listing. Kerala’s NRI Commission says visa and job-recruitment fraud accounts for over 30% of the complaints it received this year.
nri-world.nri_angle: Kerala's vast Gulf diaspora is the prime target of these rackets; the commission's data shows visa fraud is now the single largest complaint category.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Indian-Origin Couple Gives $20 Million to Create AI College at UNT
nri-world.excerpt: Anuradha and Vikas Sinha's gift to the University of North Texas will establish the Anuradha and Vikas Sinha College of Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Analytics — the couple's third major investment in the university that educated them.
nri-world.image_caption: Anuradha Sinha and Dr. Vikas Sinha pose for a photograph. The Indian-origin couple donated $20 million to the University of North Texas to establish the Anuradha and Vikas Sinha College of Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Analytics.
nri-world.nri_angle: An Indian-immigrant couple who came to the U.S. as students are now endowing a named AI college — a landmark example of diaspora philanthropy paying forward the opportunities international education gave them.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Indian-American Author Neal Bakshi Says He Was Detained at US Border After Greenland Holiday
nri-world.excerpt: The entrepreneur and US citizen, who holds Global Entry clearance, described being pulled into a windowless room with other people of colour and questioned about his affiliations.
nri-world.nri_angle: An Indian-American citizen's border detention despite Global Entry clearance has heightened fears of racial profiling among Indian diaspora travellers.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Shots Fired at Ammy Virk's Convoy After Canada Concert, Singer Escapes Unhurt
nri-world.excerpt: Abbotsford police are investigating after multiple rounds were fired at a vehicle in the Punjabi singer-actor's convoy following his concert in British Columbia on September 5.
nri-world.image_caption: Punjabi singer and actor Ammy Virk. Shots were fired at his convoy after a concert in Canada, though the singer was unharmed.
nri-world.nri_angle: The incident raises safety concerns for Indian performers touring abroad, particularly in Canada where the Punjabi diaspora forms a major concert audience.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: India's Envoy Meets Bangladesh President as Teesta Water Diplomacy Takes Centre Stage
nri-world.excerpt: High Commissioner Dinesh Trivedi's first meeting with President Alamgir focused on fair sharing of common river waters ahead of the Ganga Water Treaty renewal.
nri-world.image_caption: Indian High Commissioner Dinesh Trivedi meets Bangladesh President Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir at Bangabhaban on September 8, 2026. The meeting focused on bilateral ties and fair sharing of common river waters.
nri-world.nri_angle: The India-Bangladesh diplomatic reset has direct implications for the large Bangladeshi diaspora and for Indians with business, family and cultural ties across the border.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: How NRI Pensioners Can Submit Life Certificates Without Traveling to India
nri-world.excerpt: The Department of Pension and Pensioners' Welfare provides four alternative routes for pensioners living abroad to keep their Employees' Pension Scheme payments active.
nri-world.image_caption: India's Employees' Provident Fund Organisation manages the EPS-95 pension scheme. NRI pensioners must submit an annual life certificate to continue receiving payments.
nri-world.nri_angle: Directly affects NRI retirees who depend on Indian pension payments but cannot travel to India annually for mandatory life certificate submission.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: NPS for NRIs: What Happens to Your Retirement Account When You Move Abroad
nri-world.excerpt: PFRDA allows NRIs to continue their NPS Tier I accounts through NRE or NRO bank accounts, but Tier II is off-limits — and renouncing citizenship triggers separate closure rules.
nri-world.image_caption: India's National Pension System. NRIs who return to India or move abroad face specific rules around their NPS accounts, withdrawals and tax treatment.
nri-world.nri_angle: Directly answers a common question for Indians moving abroad: whether their NPS savings are accessible and what restrictions apply.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Hera CEO Jenny Lee's Jaipur Wedding to Indian-Origin Entrepreneur Goes Viral
nri-world.excerpt: Jenny Lee of healthcare startup Hera and Sagar Jajoo of Silna Health married in a multi-day Jaipur celebration blending Western and Hindu traditions, with her sangeet dance drawing over 700,000 Instagram views.
nri-world.nri_angle: Two UC Berkeley graduates — one American, one Indian-origin — both building healthcare startups in New York, chose Jaipur for a cross-cultural wedding that blended Christian and Hindu traditions.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: IIT Madras Opens 17 Online Courses to Class 9 Students for First Time
nri-world.excerpt: The October 2026 cohort of IIT Madras's School Connect programme extends eligibility to Class 9, offering eight-week courses across 17 disciplines from Data Science to Aerospace.
nri-world.nri_angle: Online format makes IIT Madras's School Connect accessible to diaspora families exploring Indian academic pathways for their children.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: "Talent Is Universal, Opportunity Is Not": Wadhwani Foundation CEO Dr. Ajay Kela on Why the Diaspora's Greatest Asset Isn't Money
nri-world.excerpt: In an exclusive interview with The Videshi, the CEO of Wadhwani Foundation talks about India's innovation ecosystem, the "missing middle" of Indian entrepreneurship, and why the diaspora's most powerful currency isn't capital — it's knowledge.
nri-world.image_caption: Dr. Ajay Kela, CEO and Board Member of Wadhwani Foundation, leads the organization's mission to create 5 million jobs and upskill 25 million people across emerging economies.
nri-world.nri_angle: Interview with Dr. Ajay Kela, NRI leader who returned to India to lead Wadhwani Foundation — covers diaspora giving back, deep-tech opportunities, and India's innovation ecosystem.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: F-1 Fixed-Admission Rule Takes Effect September 15: What Indian Students Must Do
immigration.excerpt: A DHS final rule replaces decades-old duration-of-status admissions with a fixed 'admit until date' on the Form I-94 - after which students must extend their stay or depart.
immigration.nri_angle: Indian students and their families plan multi-year degrees around a stable immigration framework that now carries a hard expiration date - and any international travel after September 15 means readmission under the new fixed-date system.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Canada to Let Eligible Work Permit Holders Study Without a Study Permit
immigration.excerpt: IRCC's new temporary measure allows eligible foreign workers to take short-term courses without a separate study permit through December 31, 2027 — a practical boost for professionals upgrading skills while on the job.
immigration.nri_angle: Indian professionals are among the largest groups of temporary foreign workers in Canada, so a simpler path to short professional courses directly affects their career mobility.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: UK Warns Visa Applicants: Don't Book Travel Until Your Decision Arrives
immigration.excerpt: Home Office updates both processing-time pages to state UKVI will not cover travel costs if applications are refused or delayed.
immigration.image_caption: The GOV.UK portal. The Home Office updated its visa processing-time guidance on September 9, 2026, warning applicants not to book travel until they receive a decision.
immigration.nri_angle: Indian applicants are among the largest UK visa cohorts; the new wording puts the cost of premature travel bookings squarely on applicants.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Techies Still Rule H-1B Banking Hires as $100K Fee Reshapes Sponsorship
immigration.excerpt: Analysis of 17,500 filings shows engineers win nearly half of bank H-1Bs while front-office hires top $300k — as a new $100,000 application fee changes the maths.
immigration.image_caption: A chart of H-1B Labor Condition Applications by employer for 2023. Analysis of 17,500 filings shows technology staff win just under half of H-1B sponsorships at the five largest US banks.
immigration.nri_angle: Indians are the largest H-1B beneficiaries; the data shows tech skills remain the surest sponsorship route while the $100k fee squeezes entry-level analyst pipelines.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: US Suspends Cognizant's Green Card Filings Amid Federal Fraud Investigation
immigration.excerpt: The Labor Department has blocked the IT giant from filing new PERM applications as federal authorities investigate alleged fraud involving H-1B and employment-based immigration programmes.
immigration.image_caption: Cognizant Technology Solutions headquarters. The US Department of Labor has suspended the company's permanent labor certification filings amid a federal fraud investigation.
immigration.nri_angle: The suspension creates uncertainty for thousands of Indian tech professionals whose long-term US residency plans depend on employer-sponsored PERM filings.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Trump Backs Proposed $103,000 H-1B Fee in Labor Day Proclamation

lifestyle-health.title: India Embeds Ayurveda and Yoga in Global Trade Deals as Experts Press for Standards
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Three major trade agreements with the EU, Oman, and New Zealand include formal provisions for AYUSH systems, but credible evidence and regulation remain the missing pieces.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: Traditional Ayurvedic herbs and preparations. India is embedding Ayurveda, Yoga, and other AYUSH systems into formal trade agreements with the EU, Oman, and New Zealand.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: The India-EU FTA's recognition of AYUSH qualifications could give diaspora communities in Europe better access to qualified Ayurveda and Yoga practitioners.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Weight-Loss Drug Prescriptions for US Children Under 12 Surge 310-Fold Since 2019
lifestyle-health.excerpt: A new NYU Langone study finds 20,282 children ages 8 to 11 received GLP-1 drugs like Wegovy and Zepbound, with access disparities already emerging along income lines.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: For Indian-American parents, the study highlights rising childhood obesity rates in the US and emerging access gaps that may affect South Asian communities with elevated metabolic risks.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: What Should Kids Study in the Age of AI? The Answer Is Shifting Fast.
lifestyle-health.excerpt: As nearly half of college students rethink their majors because of AI, educators and employers are converging on a new set of skills: critical thinking, adaptability, and the ability to ask better questions.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: Students using an interactive whiteboard in a classroom. Experts say the rapid rise of AI is reshaping what skills children need to learn.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Indian diaspora parents invest heavily in their children's education and career preparation; this piece speaks directly to the question of what skills matter as AI reshapes the job market.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Lippan Kaam: How Gujarat’s Ancient Mud-and-Mirror Craft Is Transforming Modern Homes
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Once confined to the circular huts of Kutch, the centuries-old art of lippan — mixing clay, camel dung, and mirrors into shimmering wall panels — is finding a new audience among urban homeowners and interior designers worldwide.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: Traditional lippan kaam, a mud-and-mirror wall art from the Kutch region of Gujarat. The centuries-old craft is experiencing a revival in modern interior design.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Traditional Kutchi craft gaining popularity among diaspora families as a way to bring Indian heritage into their homes abroad.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Black Sesame Seeds: 6 Health Benefits of Kala Til, According to Experts
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Nutrition scientists separate evidence from hype on the trending superfood that Indian kitchens have used for centuries.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: Black sesame seeds, known as kala til in Hindi. The nutrient-dense seeds contain higher levels of calcium, iron, and antioxidants than their white counterparts.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Black sesame seeds have been a staple of Indian kitchens for centuries as kala til, used in laddoos, chutneys, and Ayurvedic remedies — now Western nutrition science is catching up.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: 13 Percent of Indian Employees Face High Burnout as AI Threatens 20 Percent Job Cuts
lifestyle-health.excerpt: A Great Place To Work India study of 5.7 million employees finds persistent burnout, declining discretionary effort, and growing anxiety over AI-driven workforce reductions.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: Around 13 percent of Indian employees report high-level burnout, according to Great Place To Work India, as AI-driven restructuring threatens up to 20 percent of jobs.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Indian diaspora professionals in the U.S. and globally face similar pressures around AI adoption, burnout and shifting workplace expectations.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: India Gets Blood Test to Detect Hidden Cancer Recurrence After Treatment
lifestyle-health.excerpt: MedGenome has launched OncoTrack MRD, described as India's first indigenous blood test that can detect residual cancer at the molecular level even when scans show no visible disease.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: Blood samples in a hematology laboratory. India has approved a blood test that detects minimal residual disease, helping oncologists catch hidden cancer recurrence after treatment.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: The advancement in India's precision oncology capabilities is relevant to NRIs tracking healthcare developments in India, particularly those with family members undergoing cancer treatment back home.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: 'I Won't Eat From Your Hands': Kerala Chef's Reply to Skin-Tone Troll Goes Viral
food.excerpt: Chef Karthikeyan answered a troll who mocked his skin tone by listing the prominent guests he has served — a calm rebuttal that turned colourist abuse into a conversation about dignity.
food.nri_angle: Colourism travels with the diaspora, showing up in casting, workplaces and South Asian grocery aisles abroad; the chef's calm, factual rebuttal resonates across borders.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: In Bengal, Non-Veg Is Not a Treat During Durga Puja — It Is Bhog
food.excerpt: For Bengali families, mutton and hilsa offered to the Goddess on Navami are sacred prasad — a Shakta tradition that stands apart from North India's vegetarian Navratri.
food.image_caption: Bhoga served during Durga Puja in West Bengal, where non-vegetarian offerings like mutton are part of the feast.
food.nri_angle: Bengali-American families reassemble this tradition every autumn at community pujas and Bengali groceries, where khichuri bhog and Navami mutton keep the Shakta meaning of the festival alive abroad.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Sri Lankan-Style Coconut Kheema: A Creamy 350-Calorie Weeknight Dinner Fix
food.excerpt: Nutritionist-chef Aathira Sethumadhavan's recipe borrows from Sri Lanka's coconut gravies and Kerala's moilee and mappas, packing 22g of protein into a one-pan chicken kheema dinner with mushrooms and spinach.
food.image_caption: A Sri Lankan-style coconut curry. The kheema dish uses coconut milk and roasted spices for a creamy finish.
food.nri_angle: A 22g-protein one-pan dinner that fits busy Indian-American weeknights, fusing Sri Lankan coconut-gravy technique with pantry staples most diaspora kitchens already have.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Sabudana Kheer: The Creamy Fasting Dessert That Needs No Soaking
food.excerpt: This translucent tapioca-pearl kheer is a Navratri and vrat staple, but it works as an everyday dessert too — and a no-soak method cooks the pearls directly in water before the milk goes in.
food.image_caption: A bowl of sabudana kheer, the creamy tapioca-pearl dessert eaten during fasting days.
food.nri_angle: Tapioca pearls are stocked in nearly every Indian grocery in the US, and the no-soak method lets busy diaspora families make this Navratri bhog on a workday evening without planning ahead.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: How to Make Restaurant-Style Curry at Home, According to Indian Chefs
food.excerpt: From browning onions patiently to finishing with a tadka, professional chefs explain the techniques that separate restaurant gravy from homemade versions.
food.image_caption: A restaurant-style Indian curry. Professional chefs say patience and layered technique are the keys to replicating restaurant flavors at home.
food.nri_angle: For diaspora home cooks working with limited time, even applying two or three of these techniques can noticeably close the gap between weeknight cooking and restaurant quality.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Inside Bollywood Producer Jackky Bhagnani's Wholesome Weekly Meal Plan
food.excerpt: From neer dosa with chicken curry to yakhani pulao with raita, the producer shows that eating healthy doesn't have to mean eating boring.
food.image_caption: Bollywood producer Jackky Bhagnani shared his weekly meal plan on Instagram, featuring dishes from stuffed chicken with pesto to yakhani pulao with raita.
food.nri_angle: Bhagnani's mix of South Indian, Mughlai, and pan-Indian meals offers a practical template for diaspora families balancing health and traditional flavours.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: IndiGo Flight from Lucknow to Dammam Makes Emergency Landing in Ahmedabad After Bomb Note Found
travel.excerpt: All 107 passengers and six crew on flight 6E97 were deplaned safely; nothing suspicious was found after searches by police, CISF, and bomb disposal squads.
travel.nri_angle: The Lucknow-Dammam route is heavily used by Indian migrant workers in the Gulf, for whom such disruptions mean missed workdays and connecting-flight chaos.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: UK Air Traffic Glitch Diverts Bengaluru-London Air India Flight to Vienna
travel.excerpt: A technical fault at Britain's air traffic control provider forced Air India to divert, delay or cancel multiple UK services, as more than 1,000 flights were cancelled across Britain.
travel.image_caption: An Air India aircraft. A Bengaluru-London Air India flight was diverted to Vienna after a UK air traffic glitch.
travel.nri_angle: The India-UK corridor is one of the busiest for Indian travellers and British-Indian families, so the NATS failure ripples directly into diaspora travel plans on both ends.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Taylor Swift and Kelce Put NYC's Ambassadors Clubhouse and Indian Fine Dining in the Spotlight
travel.excerpt: The newlyweds chose a high-end Punjabi restaurant in Manhattan's NoMad district for their first post-wedding NYC date night, highlighting the growing stature of Indian cuisine in America's dining capital.
travel.image_caption: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce dined at Ambassadors Clubhouse, a high-end Punjabi restaurant in Manhattan's NoMad district, on September 6.
travel.nri_angle: Upscale Indian restaurants are breaking into the American celebrity mainstream, redefining how Punjabi cuisine is perceived in NYC fine-dining.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Trump Administration Moves to Scrap H-1B 60-Day Grace Period After Job Loss
carousel.excerpt: A DHS proposal published September 10 would require H-1B and other temporary workers to leave the U.S. as soon as employment ends - with Indian professionals the most exposed.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian nationals were about 71 percent of successful H-1B applicants in fiscal 2024, so eliminating the grace period would turn any tech layoff into an immediate departure order for Indian workers and their families.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: India Hosts BRICS Summit as Iran War Divides the Bloc's Newest Members
carousel.excerpt: Leaders from 11 BRICS nations gather in New Delhi on September 12-13, with the U.S.-led war on Iran - pitting Iran against fellow member UAE - testing the bloc's ability to issue a joint declaration.
carousel.nri_angle: Millions of Indian workers in the UAE and Gulf face direct exposure to the regional escalation, while crude above $100 a barrel hits India's import bill and the purchasing power of remittances - and the summit tests the strategic-autonomy leadership the diaspora watches closely.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Floating Cinema Brings Bollywood Classics to Srinagar's Dal Lake
carousel.excerpt: Srinagar's Dal Lake became an open-air cinema as the inaugural Jammu & Kashmir film festival screened Bollywood classics to audiences on shikaras and the lakefront.
carousel.image_caption: Houseboats on Dal Lake in Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir. The floating cinema of the International Film Festival of Jammu & Kashmir screened Bollywood classics from the lakefront, with audiences watching in shikaras.
carousel.nri_angle: For diaspora audiences who grew up on these classics, the floating cinema revives a shared cinematic inheritance — Kashmir's Bollywood-era imagery shown on the water where it was filmed.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: India Women's Spinners Bundle Pakistan Out for 55 in Asia Cup Rout
carousel.excerpt: Left-arm spinner Shree Charani's 3 for 7 led a spin masterclass in Dubai, and Harmanpreet Kaur sealed a seven-wicket win in 8.4 overs in her 150th T20I as captain.
carousel.nri_angle: India-Pakistan cricket is appointment viewing for the South Asian diaspora, and this rout gave fans across the US, Canada, UK and the Gulf a night to savour.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Accenture, Google Cloud Launch Unit Deploying 1,000 AI Engineers On-Site
carousel.excerpt: Google Cloud will train up to 1,000 Accenture engineers to work inside client offices building AI applications — the industry's latest bet that embedded, forward-deployed talent is the key to AI returns.
carousel.image_caption: The Google Cloud logo on display. Accenture and Google Cloud have formed the Accenture Gemini Enterprise Business Group, which will train up to 1,000 engineers to deploy agentic AI inside client offices.
carousel.nri_angle: Accenture's large Indian-origin workforce and India's global capability centers sit at the center of the enterprise AI deployment wave this new unit aims to staff.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Sensex Crashes 813 Points as $100 Oil and West Asia Tensions Rattle Markets
carousel.excerpt: The benchmark fell for a third straight session to 74,764 as Brent crude topped $100 and IT stocks led a broad selloff; India VIX jumped over 6%.
carousel.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building on Dalal Street in Mumbai. The BSE Sensex crashed 813 points on Wednesday as crude oil topped $100 a barrel amid escalating West Asia tensions.
carousel.nri_angle: NRIs with India equity exposure face a triple hit: falling stock prices, a weakening rupee and $100 crude squeezing corporate margins.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk
